label: EOR Projects · Illustrative operating concepts
limitations: Surveyed well paths establish location, not fluid movement.
Symbolic flow animation and concept diagrams do not show measured plume extent, fractures, pressure fronts, saturations, volumes or rates.
No daily or monthly EOR series is invented. Operator names describe the cited project records.
learningNotes: Injection adds pressure and brings fluid into contact with reservoir rock; the contacted region depends on fractures, rock and fluid properties.
Production lowers pressure at the well and recovers connected fluids. Incremental recovery requires comparison with an appropriate production baseline.
A shut-in or monitored well need not be an injector. An application, authorization, modeled plan and reported field operation are distinct evidence types.
